ArtifactRef per FB-RAT-COM-011 — a digest-addressed reference to a byte artifact (build output, imported file, model weights, log bundle, etc.). Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<ArtifactRef> (see envelope.schema.json), inheriting schemaVersion/producer/createdAtUtc from that outer envelope; `id` below is this object's own FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID.
title: ArtifactRef

id.description: Globally unique stable ID for this artifact (FB-RAT-COM-002), independent of storageLocation or filename — a moved or re-hosted artifact keeps the same id.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte length of the artifact (FB-RAT-COM-005) — MUST equal `digest.byteLength`; kept as a separate top-level field because ArtifactRef is frequently filtered/sorted by size without needing to reach into `digest`.

producerReceipt.description: Provenance of this artifact (FB-RAT-COM-008 — 'every execution/model/import result records source location, project revision, initiating principal, evidence links'). Null only for artifacts predating this convention or synthesized for a fixture/test; a real producer MUST populate it.

locator.description: Kind-specific locator string: an absolute local path (LOCAL_FS), a CAS key (CONTENT_ADDRESSED_STORE), a git blob/tree ref (GIT_HOST, per the REST-only GitContentsApi/GitTreeApi convention — no JGit dependency in this constellation), or a URL (REMOTE_URL). A reader MUST treat this as untrusted input and MUST reject a LOCAL_FS locator containing a '..' path-traversal segment or resolving outside the expected root.

verificationState.description: Whether digest+sizeBytes have been independently re-checked against the bytes at storageLocation since this ArtifactRef was produced. A consumer MUST NOT treat UNVERIFIED the same as VERIFIED for any security- or integrity-sensitive decision.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

receiptObjectId.description: The ContractEnvelope.objectId of the ExecutionReceipt/ImportReceipt that produced this artifact (FB-RAT-COM-002).

sourceLocation.description: Where the artifact came from (file path, URL, device path, git ref) — FB-RAT-COM-008 provenance minimum.

projectRevision.description: Project/repo revision (e.g. git commit SHA) in effect when this artifact was produced — FB-RAT-COM-008.

initiatingPrincipal.description: Who or what initiated production of this artifact (user id, service account, agent name) — FB-RAT-COM-008.

evidenceLinks.description: Optional links/refs to supporting evidence (logs, receipts, screenshots) — FB-RAT-COM-008.

algorithm.description: Digest algorithm; SHA-256 or stronger only (FB-RAT-COM-005).

digestHex.description: Lowercase-hex digest of the exact bytes described by byteLength.

byteLength.description: Exact byte length of the digested content (FB-RAT-COM-005).
